start.actionDescription: Choose an action or copy its text.
image.title: Select a QR code
image.help: Choose Use whole image to scan without selecting an area. Or drag a box around the QR code, including a little margin. Use arrow keys to move the box; hold Shift to resize.
image.instructions: Choose Use whole image, or select an area and choose Read selected region.
image.loadFailed: Couldn’t open this image. Choose a supported image such as PNG, JPEG, or WebP.
image.noCode: No QR code found in the selected region. Include the whole code and some margin, or try the whole image.
image.decodeFailed: Couldn’t read this region. Try a smaller selection or another image.
image.selection: Selection: {x}% from left, {y}% from top, {width}% wide, {height}% high.
image.dropHint: Or drop an image or PDF anywhere in the app.
image.dropPrompt: Drop an image or PDF to read QR codes
image.invalidDrop: Drop an image file or PDF.
image.fallbackRegions: No candidate region decoded. Trying the whole image…
image.fallbackNoRegions: No likely QR region found. Trying the whole image…
image.noCodeWhole: No QR code found in the candidate regions or the whole image. Try selecting the QR code manually.
debug.title: Detection debug
debug.preview: Finder candidates and attempted QR regions
debug.legend: Cyan: finder candidates. Amber: unsuccessful attempts. Green: decoded. Dashed border: whole-image fallback. Finder responses are clues, not probabilities.
debug.regions: Found {count} candidate regions from finder patterns.
debug.fallback: Candidate scan did not decode a QR code. Trying the whole image.
debug.successRegion: Decoded a QR code from candidate region {index}.
debug.successWhole: Candidate scan did not decode a QR code. The whole-image fallback succeeded.
debug.failed: No QR code decoded from candidate regions or the whole image.
debug.locatorFailed: Region analysis failed; the full-image decoder was still tried.
pdf.found: Found {count} QR code(s) on this page.
pdf.noCode: No QR code found on this page.
pdf.pageError: Couldn’t scan this page. Other pages will still be processed.
pdf.complete: Finished {processed} of {pages} pages: {codes} QR code(s), {errors} page error(s).
pdf.stopped: Scanning stopped. Completed page results are kept.
pdf.loadFailed: Couldn’t open this PDF. Choose a valid PDF or try another file.
pdf.passwordProtected: This PDF requires a password. Choose an unlocked copy to scan it.
debug.multiple: Decoded {count} distinct QR codes in this scan.
pdf.pageStopped: Scanning stopped before this page finished.
